title: Coefficient-first étale support projection map
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism with compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{p}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the small étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $A$ be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions [def-weil-derived-tensor]; assume étale inverse images preserve flat objects, and equip $A$ with a concrete forgetful functor to sets reflecting isomorphisms and preserving filtered colimits, with sheaf composition on every small étale site. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $F=Rp_*j_!$, and let $\mathrm{PF}_c$ be the canonical compactification projection [sk-def-sf-exchanges]. Define the bifunctors $S_c(K,L)=L\otimes^L FK$ and $T_c(K,L)=F(f^*L\otimes^L K)$. With $\sigma$ the signed derived tensor symmetry [lem-kun-tensor-sym], define their natural transformation by $S_c\xrightarrow{\sigma_Y^{-1}}(FK\otimes^LL)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PF}_c}F(K\otimes^Lf^*L)\xrightarrow{F(\sigma_X)}T_c$. This is a definition of the actual map, with no assertion of invertibility, shift coherence or unit coherence.
